description: This file defines the ActionService class, which contains business logic related to managing corrective actions within the defect management system. It provides methods to list, create, update, delete, and count overdue actions associated with defects.

classes.name: ActionService
classes.description: A service class that manages business logic for corrective actions related to defects, including listing, creating, updating, deleting, and counting overdue actions.

methods.name: listByDefect
methods.description: Retrieves a list of corrective actions associated with a specific defect identified by defectId.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new corrective action linked to a specified defect using the data provided in the request.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing corrective action identified by actionId with new details provided in the request.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the corrective action identified by actionId from the system.

methods.name: countOverdue
methods.description: Counts the number of overdue actions, i.e., actions with status not marked as DONE and due date before today.
